_about: The English pages that are localised. Everything else stays as it is: the legal pages (privacy, terms, abuse) are English-only on purpose - a machine translation of a legal text is worse than the original - and pages that are redirects, the Worker's unused fallbacks and the webapp are not localised here. Links from a localised page to an unlisted page go to the English one. `node scripts/i18n-web.mjs check` fails on any English .html page under apps/web/public that is in neither `pages` nor `englishOnly` (each with its reason), outside the generated language folders and the `ownI18n` trees, so a new page cannot ship English-only by accident. The open-in-app page (open/index.html) and the Studio download page are served by the Worker at fixed URLs (/join ..., /studio); it picks the built copy for the visitor's language (apps/com/src/route.ts localisedPage, same rule as the first-visit redirect).
